title: Three Stats, Three Functions
prompt: Implement `min_of`, `max_of` (both return int; empty vector returns 0), and `avg_of` (double, empty returns 0.0) over a vector of ints.

tests.name: min
tests.hint: Track the smallest while visiting once.

tests.name: max
tests.hint: Track the largest while visiting once.

tests.name: avg
tests.hint: Return a real division as double.
